headline: Weathered Expanse Leads the Firing as Marban Hollow Cools
war_summary: The night's tidings speak of a shifting storm. The Weathered Expanse now leads the firing: twenty-six actions in the day, fourteen inside six hours and three within two, the last logged as this edition went to press, with Crow's Nest the busiest ground. Warden losses there ran to 7,506 over twenty-four hours against 4,335 Colonial; the balance stands five posts Colonial, three Warden, one wrecked. Mooring County flared at press time, three strikes inside two hours and two-hour losses near 1,100 a side, though all twelve of its posts remain Warden-held. Palantine Berm counted forty-five actions, twenty within six hours, Leiri Hermanni hardest hit, yet all seven posts stay Warden-held. Stlican Shelf logged ten actions through the day, eight of nine posts Colonial-held. The Nevish Line, still the day's leader at fifty actions, has filed nothing since 21:16, its ledger six Warden, one Colonial, one in ruin. Marban Hollow's guns have cooled, hourly losses down to single figures, one post rubble, seven in Colonial hands. Callahan's Passage has seen no base action since mid-morning even as two-hour losses topped 1,100 Colonial and 1,500 Warden. It is day 487; thirty-four victory towns decide this war, and no victor is named.
